Class RabbitMessagePublisher

java.lang.Object
com.sca4d.messaging.rabbit.RabbitMessagePublisher
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.sca4d.core.api.messaging.MessagePublisher
@Internal public final class RabbitMessagePublisher extends Object implements com.sca4d.core.api.messaging.MessagePublisher
实现立即、提交后和 Outbox 三种业务消息发布时机。
